model_annotation: Figure 10 illustrates the effects of Targ and Permute on case masking, grouped by language family. The horizontal axis represents language families, listed in alphabetical order as Albanian, Baltic, Celtic, Germanic, Indo-Iranian, Japanese, Korean, Romance, Slavic, and Uralic. The vertical axis, labeled "error deviation," is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 0.2, with tick labels at 0.0, 0.1, and 0.2. Two bars are presented for each language family, one representing Targ and the other Permute, distinguished by color: Targ is shown in blue and Permute in orange. The Targ bars consistently have lower values than the Permute bars across all language families. The shortest bar, representing Targ for the Japanese language family, has an approximate value of 0.02, while the tallest bar, representing Permute for the Slavic language family, has an approximate value of 0.18. Error bars, represented as vertical lines extending from the top of each bar, are present and indicate the standard deviation. The Slavic language family's Permute bar has the largest error bar, extending to approximately 0.12 above the bar itself.
